sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: We only collect your email, username, avatar, your preferences (theme, language) and the messages you send through chat. If you sign in with the 42 intra, we receive your 42 login.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: This data runs your account, authentication, friend list, chat and online presence. No data is ever sold.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Data is kept as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, your messages, friendships and blocks are deleted.

sections.title: Cookies & session
sections.body: A technical httpOnly cookie stores your refresh token to keep you signed in. No advertising cookies are used.

sections.title: Your rights (GDPR)
sections.body: You can access, correct or request deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about your data, contact the Transcendence project team.

sections.title: Acceptance
sections.body: By creating an account you accept these terms of service.

sections.title: Account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your credentials private and for the activity on your account. One username per person.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: No harassment, spam or illegal content in chat. You can block any user at any time.

sections.title: Content
sections.body: You remain responsible for the messages you send. We may remove content or suspend an account in case of abuse.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: Transcendence is an educational project provided as is, with no availability guarantee.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may change. The last update date is shown at the top of this page.
